tool_source_state: binary-only (.pyc); helper-disable mechanism is the same runtime monkey-patch (scripts/run_pure.py) used in pyrat_strict_20260527/. The ONLY difference vs that sibling archive is the abstract domain selection.

domain_selection.explanation: PyRAT's internal AnalysisParam._domains_clean() unconditionally appends 'con_z' to the domain list whenever 'hyb_z' is selected. This is because the hyb_z (Hybrid Zonotope) abstraction is constructed on top of a constrained-zonotope carrier and is meaningless without it. Both domains are computed per layer and the tightest per-element bound is kept. This is intrinsic to the PyRAT hyb_z implementation, NOT a configuration error — confirmed by reading the bytecode of pyrat.analyzer.analysis_param.AnalysisParam._domains_clean. Verdicts in this archive thus represent PyRAT's 'hyb_z + con_z carrier' analysis. The sibling pyrat_strict_20260527/ archive isolates 'con_z alone'.

hyb_z_knobs.split_relu: false (forced; split_relu would re-trigger con_z BaB branching that competes with hyb_z and dominates the abstraction)
hyb_z_knobs.rationale: max_hybz=-1 lets PyRAT use unbounded HZ count; iterative_hybz=False uses full HZ from the start (max precision); hybz_relu_method=False is the Ortiz-et-al-2023 (arxiv 2304.02755) abstraction which is the PyRAT default and exact for ReLU.

chain wrapper restarted, GPU-only ordered queue + CPU-only standalone in parallel
third stream added for medium GPU benches (cora,malbeware,metaroom,yolo,ml4acopf,collins_rul_cnn)
after chain reached relusplitter, switched to standalone workers=3
